description: Human-readable labels for the frozen BERTopic topic IDs. This registry is the authoritative label mapping applied to data/processed/customer_support_topics.csv, the star schema, the Power BI export and dashboard, and the API. The labels remain exploratory, human-interpreted themes (review_status: proposed), not a validated ground-truth issue taxonomy.
topic_run: BERTopic run committed in b94ed5c, reduced to 30 topics (-1 to 28). Topic IDs are frozen; BERTopic is not rerun.
evidence_method: Distinctive terms and recurring template sentences per topic, computed from data/processed/customer_support_topics.csv joined to the cleaned ticket descriptions.
